parameters.notes: REAL Tool Gateway. Providers: SerpAPI Google Shopping (primary commercial) + Tavily (web research/evidence). eBay nodes are INACTIVE (NOT REQUIRED, kept for audit history; activate only with EBAY_ENABLED=true + creds). Missing creds -> UNAVAILABLE retryable:false. Amazon/Flipkart filtered. SerpAPI key via $env.SERPAPI_API_KEY (compose) or query-auth credential. Input: {tool, query|url|serpapi_product_id, max_results}. Output: envelopes.

nodes.name: Tavily Search
nodes.notes: Key via $env.TAVILY_API_KEY (compose passthrough). Credential alternative documented in README.
